intake.problem_statement: Factory floor monitoring dashboard for a 90-minute live coding interview. See PROBLEM-STATEMENT.md at the repo root.
business_goals: Operator can identify the highest-severity open problem within 5 seconds of landing
Acknowledging a problem takes one click
New critical alerts are visible without a manual refresh
in_scope: Factory overview KPIs and connection state
Active alerts list with severity/location filters and acknowledge
Alert-volume handling (severity chips, grouping by machine, bulk acknowledge) per PM guidance: ~20 alerts/day typical, 50+ on a bad day
Zone health ranked by attention needed
Live alert/telemetry updates over the provided mock WebSocket
out_of_scope: Changes to the real backend or MSW mocks
intake.additional_context: Direct input from the PM during planning: 'NO OF ALERTS avg would be around 20 and bad day around 50+, best way to handle that smartly is the only addition.' This drove FR-019 through FR-024 (severity chips, grouping by machine, bulk acknowledge, info collapse, stable live-update ordering, search).
